stories.title: Morte avvelenate con la ricina, Gianni Di Vita portato in Questura. Perquisiti i due studi

en.title: Deaths by ricin poisoning, Gianni Di Vita taken to police headquarters. Two offices searched
en.summary: Gianni Di Vita, father and husband of poisoning victims, was brought in for questioning as authorities searched two offices. A bag belonging to Antonella Di Ielsi was seized during the searches.

stories.title: A casa del 17enne arrestato a Trento manuali per bombe, spade e vessilli nazisti. Nel telefono i piani per attaccare «politici, gay ed ebrei»

en.title: Bomb manuals, swords and Nazi flags found at arrested 17-year-old's home in Trento. Phone contained plans to attack "politicians, gay people and Jews"
en.summary: Police discovered bomb-making instructions, weapons, and Nazi materials at the residence of a 17-year-old arrested in Trento. The suspect's phone contained immediate action plans targeting specific groups.

stories.title: Caso Garlasco, l’ex Ris Portera: “Non ho fatto io l’analisi del Dna sulla bici di Alberto Stasi”

en.title: Garlasco case, former RIS officer Portera: "I did not conduct the DNA analysis on Alberto Stasi's bicycle"
en.summary: A retired geneticist and former RIS official told prosecutors his name was only associated with a system access entry, denying he performed DNA analysis in the Garlasco case.

stories.title: Morte avvelenate, Gianni Di Vita portato in Questura

en.title: Deaths by poisoning, Gianni Di Vita taken to police headquarters
en.summary: Gianni Di Vita, the father and husband of poisoning victims, was brought to police headquarters while a second office of his was searched as part of the investigation.

stories.title: Inneggiava al suprematismo e aveva armi bianche in casa, arrestato 17enne

en.title: 17-year-old arrested for praising supremacism and possessing bladed weapons at home
en.summary: Police in Verona arrested a 17-year-old from Trento province in connection with white supremacist propaganda and the discovery of bladed weapons in his residence.

stories.title: Suprematismo neonazista, arrestato un 17enne: in casa manuali per attentati e armi bianche

en.title: Neo-Nazi supremacist arrested, 17-year-old: manuals for attacks and bladed weapons found at home
en.summary: Verona police arrested a 17-year-old who reportedly praised white supremacists and held an active role in a neo-fascist online community, with investigators discovering attack manuals and weapons.

stories.title: Caso Garlasco, su Stasi: "Nascoste prove a favore", Sempio verso il processo

en.title: Garlasco case, on Stasi: "Evidence in favor hidden", Sempio heading to trial
en.summary: Prosecutors allege evidence was concealed in a criminal investigation, with fingerprint analysis suggesting suspect Andrea Sempio's connection while challenging DNA evidence previously attributed to victim Chiara Stasi.

stories.title: È morto il fotografo Umberto Pizzi, ha raccontato 60 anni di storia italiana

en.title: Photographer Umberto Pizzi dies, documented 60 years of Italian history
en.summary: Renowned photographer Umberto Pizzi has died; his work captured major events and figures spanning six decades of Italian cultural and political life, including celebrity stories and Roman high society.

stories.title: Morte avvelenate, perquisito lo studio di Gianni Di Vita: “L’ex sindaco portato in questura”

en.title: Deaths by poisoning, studio of Gianni Di Vita searched: 'Former mayor taken to police station'
en.summary: Nine months after two women died, a man connected to the victims has become central to the investigation. Ricin traces were found among samples collected from a residence.

stories.title: Addio a Umberto Pizzi, morto l’ultimo paparazzo della dolce vita. Ha immortalato dive e politici

en.title: Farewell to Umberto Pizzi, the last paparazzo of the dolce vita dies. He immortalized stars and politicians
en.summary: A photographer aged 87 passed away after decades documenting entertainment and political figures through his lens.

stories.title: Giallo della ricina, il marito portato in questura dopo la perquisizione nel suo studio

en.title: Ricin mystery, husband taken to police station after search of his studio
en.summary: The investigation into the deaths of Antonella Di Ielsi and her daughter Sara is narrowing in scope.

stories.title: Addio a Umberto Pizzi, fotografo della Dolce Vita e testimone di vizi e difetti dei vip

en.title: Farewell to Umberto Pizzi, photographer of the Dolce Vita and witness to the vices and flaws of celebrities
en.summary: A photographer aged 89 passed away after a career documenting major cinema stars and publishing two books.

stories.title: Piombino, via libera Ue all’acquisizione di Liberty Magona da parte di Trasteel

en.title: Piombino, EU green light for Trasteel's acquisition of Liberty Magona
en.summary: European antitrust authorities have approved Trasteel, an Italian-Swiss steel production and trading company, to acquire the historic Liberty Magona steelworks in Piombino.

stories.title: Il valore della pubblicità nel retail media verso il miliardo di euro

en.title: The value of retail media advertising heading toward one billion euros
en.summary: The retail media market, encompassing online and offline advertising spaces offered by modern retail chains, is experiencing double-digit growth as it approaches a billion-euro valuation.

stories.title: Aumento di capitale da 13,5 milioni per Complaion

en.title: Capital increase of 13.5 million for Complaion
en.summary: Complaion, a startup founded in 2024, is raising 13.5 million euros to support its expansion in a rapidly growing market focused on assisting European small and medium enterprises.

stories.title: Marano: «Le Big Tech restituiscano agli editori la ricchezza che prelevano»

en.title: Marano: "Big Tech should return to publishers the wealth they extract"
en.summary: A spokesperson argues that major technology companies capture advertising revenue while publishers lose resources, ultimately placing the burden on citizens who depend on increasingly underfunded news organizations.

stories.title: Baraclit festeggia gli 80 anni con 200 milioni di ordini e investimenti green

en.title: Baraclit celebrates 80 years with 200 million orders and green investments
en.summary: Baraclit, a leading Italian prefabricated concrete industrial group based in Bibbiena, marks its 80th anniversary with record financial results and 200 million in orders, while pursuing green investments.
